$comment: Reviewed high/critical advisories with no resolvable version in range. `bun run audit` fails only on advisories absent from this list. Regenerate with `bun run audit:baseline` and justify each new entry.

entries.title: brace-expansion: DoS via unbounded expansion length causing an out-of-memory process crash
entries.note: Dev-only: eslint@9.39.5 > @eslint/config-array > minimatch@3.1.5 > brace-expansion@1.1.18. Lint-time config matching, never part of the deployed site. First patched version is 5.0.8, so the pinned 1.x line has no fix in range — unresolvable here until eslint moves off minimatch 3. The OOM needs an attacker-supplied glob; the only patterns here are our own eslint config.

entries.title: path-to-regexp outputs backtracking regular expressions
entries.note: Build-only: @astrojs/vercel > @vercel/routing-utils, which pins path-to-regexp at exactly 6.1.0 (it also carries a patched 6.3.0 under an alias for newer behaviour, so no range bump resolves this). It runs once during `astro build` to compile the route table into .vercel/output/config.json; it is not in the deployed function. The ReDoS needs an attacker-controlled route pattern, and the patterns are our own file names under src/pages. Drops off when @vercel/routing-utils moves to the aliased copy.
